plan: My goal is to maximize profit. Since I pay the second-highest bid if I win, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy in a second-price auction. Bidding higher than my value risks losing money if I win, and bidding lower risks losing a profitable opportunity. Therefore, I will bid my value.

My value is $28. In a second-price auction, the optimal strategy is to bid my true value. This maximizes my chances of winning when it's profitable and ensures I never pay more than my value. Since this is the first and only round, I will stick to this dominant strategy.

This is a single-round auction, so I don't need to worry about long-term strategy or learning from past rounds. My goal is to maximize profit in this round. In a Vickrey auction (second-price sealed-bid), the optimal strategy is to bid your true value. This ensures that if I win, I pay the second-highest bid, and my profit is my value minus that bid. Bidding less than my value risks losing when I could have won profitably. Bidding more than my value risks winning and paying more than my value.
